crossRefs.note: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

parallels.note: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

translations.web: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;
translations.bsb: For six years you may sow your field and prune your vineyard and gather its crops.
translations.kjv: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruit
translations.asv: Six years thou shalt sow thy field, and six years thou shalt prune thy vineyard, and gather in the fruits thereof;
